title: hotfix: fix SLO enforcer backoff causing regional thrashing during failover
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: - Fix: SLO enforcer backoff logic causing rapid regional failover thrashing under transient errors. No API changes. Rolling restart recommended for private deployments if running older enforcer binary.
description: Background: During a recent incident we observed the SLO enforcer enter a backoff loop that aggressively ramped regional failover decisions when transient RPC errors spiked. This caused repeated cross-region failovers (thrashing) and contributed to elevated tail latency. Root cause: a combination of (1) exponential backoff being reset incorrectly on successful probes, and (2) the regional scoring window not discounting short-lived error bursts. Changes in this PR: 1) Fix backoff state machine so successful probe clears backoff and only increases after a sustained error window; 2) Add short-burst suppression to regional scoring to ignore sub-30s error spikes; 3) Introduce a max-failover-rate limiter (configured via feature flag) to prevent more than one automated regional failover per 5m per-customer by default; 4) Add unit and integration tests for backoff transitions and scoring; 5) Add observability: new metrics slo_enforcer.backoff_state, slo_enforcer.failover_rate_limiter.{allowed,blocked} and tracing spans on decision path. Rollout plan: hotfix deployed to dedicated Canary region first, monitored for 1 hour, then gradual roll to remaining regions; feature flag default ON for hosted, opt-out for Private deployments until customers upgrade agent. Testing: unit tests added, e2e harness run against synthetic transient error scenarios, manual validation with canary traffic replicating the incident pattern. Impact: reduces chance of automated thrashing while preserving failover responsiveness for sustained region-level degradation. Follow-ups: tune suppression window and failover rate defaults based on 72h telemetry; add a per-route override to support latency-critical customers. Checklist: [x] repro and root-cause analysis [x] code fix + tests [x] observability added [x] canary rollout plan [x] release notes
